votes.motion: A motion was made by Cyndi Sharkey, seconded by Zach Robinson to approve the Consent Calendar

A motion was made by Ryan Mecham, seconded by Marci Houseman to adopt Ordinance 25-25, an ordinance amending the Sandy City Municipal Code Title 21, "Land Development Code", Chapter 3 "Officers, Board and Commissions", Chapter 30 "Subdivision Review", and Chapter 37 "Definitions"
A motion was made by Brooke D'Sousa, seconded by Marci Houseman to recess the Council meeting and convene a meeting of the Alta Canyon Recreation Special Service District Board

A motion was made by Brooke D'Sousa, seconded by Ryan Mecham to convene a closed session in the Council Conference Room to discuss the purchase, exchange or lease of real property, and adjourn the Council meeting immediately following the closed session
